description: Consolidated Phase 4.3 evidence: --workers CLI integration into scripts/run_backtest_engine_v01_optimized.py itself (not just the standalone benchmark script), 4-path (Baseline/Julia x Primary/Sensitivity) trade parity, metrics/LG-cohort parity, persistent Fast/Monthly feature cache content parity, and a genuine cross-process warm-reuse verification of a parallel-built cache.

runner_integration.warm_cache_fallback_policy: workers>1 requested + persistent_cache_hit=True -> falls back to effective_workers=1 for that run (Cold Parallel Build Mode only, w.md Section 9-10 Option A)

note_on_speedup_measurement: Both N=100 and N=250 workers=1/workers=2 runs were executed sequentially (never concurrently) via scripts/run_backtest_engine_v01_optimized.py --limit N --workers {1,2} to avoid CPU contention skewing the comparison. wall_clock speedup is lower than the pure-simulation speedup because the ~33-34s Proxy Method Validation phase is not parallelized (unchanged from Phase 4.2 scope) and is a fixed cost included in wall_clock_total_seconds for both workers modes. speedup_simulation_only_x = (workers1 primary_simulation_seconds + workers1 sensitivity_simulation_seconds) / (workers2 primary_simulation_seconds) -- the parallel path folds Sensitivity into the single combined 4-pass-per-ticker phase, so its sensitivity_simulation_seconds is reported as 0.0 (not separately measurable, NOT 'took zero time') and the workers=1 numerator must include both of its phases for an apples-to-apples ratio.

four_path_exact_trade_parity.method_pool_vs_nonpool: tests/test_backtest_performance_engine_v01_phase4_3.py (tests 4-7) -- run_parallel_universe(workers=1) vs run_parallel_universe(workers=2) on a real 10-ticker stratified sample, full StrategyTradeRecord field-exact equality (list equality, not just counts). Proves the ProcessPoolExecutor pool itself does not corrupt results, but both sides go through the SAME worker function (simulate_ticker_bundle) -- it does not exercise the legacy sequential code path.
four_path_exact_trade_parity.method_legacy_sequential_vs_parallel: tests/test_backtest_performance_engine_v01_phase4_3.py::test_workers1_workers2_persistent_cache_content_parity -- the ACTUAL legacy sequential structure run_optimized_backtest() uses for workers<=1 (one shared FastSnapshotCache/MonthlySnapshotCache across the whole universe, one context per ticker, Primary-loop-then-Sensitivity-loop, real market_cap_registry) vs run_parallel_universe(workers=2), canonically sorted, full StrategyTradeRecord field-exact equality. This is the comparison that matters for Gates B-E, since it is the only one that touches the real workers=1 production code shape.
four_path_exact_trade_parity.metrics_parity: PASS (calculate_strategy_metrics identical both ways, baseline and julia)
four_path_exact_trade_parity.loss_guard_cohort_parity: PASS (cohort accounting summary identical both ways)
four_path_exact_trade_parity.deterministic_ordering: PASS (two separate workers=2 runs produce byte-identical canonical trade lists)

persistent_feature_cache_parity.method: tests/test_backtest_performance_engine_v01_phase4_3.py::test_workers1_workers2_persistent_cache_content_parity -- fast/monthly caches built via the exact two code paths run_optimized_backtest() itself uses (sequential shared-context loop for workers<=1, run_parallel_universe for workers>1) on a real 10-ticker stratified sample (NOT the N=100 CLI-level temporary-cache-directory setup w.md Section 15 described -- the CLI currently ties persistence to `limit is None`, so an N=100 CLI-level version would need new plumbing not built this cycle), real market_cap_registry, then exported and compared key-for-key and value-for-value (NaN-safe)

cross_process_warm_verification.method: tests/test_backtest_performance_engine_v01_phase4_3.py::test_parallel_generated_persistent_cache_is_warm_hit_in_new_process -- a workers=2 cold build's fast/monthly caches are saved to a temp PersistentFeatureCacheStore, then a genuinely separate python3 subprocess loads that same cache_dir

merge_semantics.fail_closed_on_unequal_duplicate_key: PASS (FastSnapshotCache.merge_store and MonthlySnapshotCache.merge_store both raise ValueError)

minor_fixes_applied.section_18_ticker_as_name_cleanup: scripts/benchmark_parallelism_v01.py and scripts/benchmark_backtest_engine_realistic_v01.py now pass the real per-ticker name into build_precomputed_ticker_context instead of ticker-as-name (scripts/benchmark_phase4_1.py left unchanged -- its tickers: list[str] signature never carries a real name anywhere in that script, so there is no inconsistency to fix there)
minor_fixes_applied.section_19_overclaim_relabel: scripts/benchmark_phase4_1.py docstrings relabeled from 'ACTUAL 18e4078 behavior' to PHASE4_HEAD_APPROXIMATION / CURRENT_TREE_PHASE4_STYLE / PRE_WINDOW_PRUNING_DISABLED, explicitly noting the current tree already includes Phase 4.1's searchsorted/date-lookup optimizations that did not exist at 18e4078

memory_observation.note: Not measured this cycle (non-gating per w.md Section 21); N=250 workers=2 CLI run completed without any OOM/swap symptoms observed via `ps`/`time` during the run.

estimated_full_run_time_minutes.workers2_projection_using_phase4_3_measu: ~29-31 min (N=250 measured 1.81x wall-clock speedup applied to the ~52 min single-process projection)
